derivation: from an unused root meaning to open (the eyes); (compare H6597 (פִּתְאוֹם))
def: a wink, i.e. moment(used only (with or without preposition) adverbially, quickly or unexpectedly

words.word: yea it shall be at an instant

occurrences.text: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
words: yea it shall be at an instant

occurrences.text: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
